loadAtStartup._docs: Files force-loaded into session context at startup. Injected as <system-reminder> blocks.

dynamicContext._docs: Dynamic context sections injected at session start. Set to false to disable.

steering._docs: Contextual steering: PAL injects a short self-check into your prompt when it matches a task type. 'disable' removes shipped rules by tag (debugging, destructive, refactor, planning, testing, committing, secrets); 'rules' adds your own as [{ tag, pattern (JS regex, case-insensitive), snippet }]. A bad regex is skipped, never fatal. Toggle the whole feature via dynamicContext.contextualSteering.
